summary: Drift has its own fast page, menus are tidier, and queued actions apply without waiting for a long run.

new.title: Drift: live vs desired has its own page
new.text: Find it under Reviews & controls. It opens instantly, shows counts per area with the differences per row, and Check now queues a fresh check.

fixes.title: Menus make more sense
fixes.text: Daily operations joins Reviews & controls, and Manager access, the emergency override, template packs and mail templates are now sections in Settings.

fixes.title: Queued actions apply during long runs
fixes.text: A committed Temporary Access Pass re-issue or session revoke is applied between engine steps instead of after the whole run.

fixes.title: The badge counts only what needs you
fixes.text: Pending changes lists pending entries first. The red badge counts pending or failed entries, and committed ones waiting for the engine show in blue.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Review standing access hides deleted principals by default, the Access map groups related groups together, and a group created in a run is used in that run.
